dieline.layersTitle: What the layers in the file mean

layers.Bleed: Bleed: run the artwork out to this line, past the cut
layers.Safe: Safe area: keep text and logos inside this line
layers.HalfCut: Half-cut through the board (some styles only)

pdf.1: Open it in Illustrator (File › Open), not Place, so the layers are kept.
pdf.2: CutContour, Crease, Bleed and Safe are separate layers — put your artwork on a new layer below CutContour.
pdf.3: Do not edit or delete the dieline layers; the cutting die is made from them.

ai.1: Open directly in Illustrator (File › Open): every path is editable and the CutContour and Crease spot swatches are kept
ai.2: If Illustrator asks about PDF content, continue — this is the same dieline as the PDF, named .ai
ai.3: Put your artwork on a new layer under the dieline and never edit or delete the cut and crease lines

dxf.1: Open it in a CAD program or Illustrator; the units are millimetres.
dxf.2: Import at 1:1 scale, then measure one side against the size you asked for.
dxf.3: Before the die is made, check the cut and crease lines are still told apart after import.

svg.1: Opens in a browser, Illustrator, Inkscape or Figma.
svg.2: Sizes are in millimetres — in Figma, check the scale before placing artwork.
svg.3: Good for previews and mock-ups; use the PDF for print.

cake-boxes.intro:
You can order cake and bakery boxes from getpack online, from choosing a style to tracking the delivery: pick a style below, enter the inside size in millimetres (length × width × height), then choose the board, print and quantity. Styles marked "Instant price" show the price including VAT as soon as the spec is complete; for the others, press "Request a quotation" and your spec goes to the team, who reply with a price — nothing is guessed in advance.

The styles on this page suit cakes, bread and pastries — lid-and-base boxes, trays and special shapes. Many come with structural options such as a display window, a carry handle or a locking lid, where the style supports it; see each style's page, and compare several side by side before you choose.

If you know your product's size but not the box size, measure the outside of the product and use the size search in the style library: it adds 0.5 cm of room on every side and shows the styles that fit, with a recommended inside size. Each style can be turned around in 3D on its page before you decide. For a cake, include the decoration and the cake board in the height.

The board, print, coating and finishes each style supports are listed on its own set-up page, and the outside and inside are printed separately. Styles with an instant price show the new price each time you change an option; for styles that need a quotation, every option you chose goes to the team in one request.

There are three ways to the artwork: design it yourself in the 3D Studio on the real box shape, upload your own file — the team checks it before production — or have the team design it for you, with the design fee shown in the price. Signed-in customers can download each style's dieline for their own design software.

Before production you check and approve the artwork. The production time and the estimated arrival date are shown with the price and count from artwork approval and payment. The accepted tolerances for size, colour and quantity are shown before you buy and stated in the quotation. If you want to see a real one before a large run, you can ask for a sample (charged). Every order comes with a full tax invoice for the amount paid, you follow production and delivery in your account, and a reorder reuses the same spec and files, priced again at current cost. If food touches the box directly, tell the team in your quotation request or before ordering so they can advise on the board.

For styles that need a quotation, the team prices your actual spec and replies; nothing is guessed in advance.

faq.answer: The production time and the estimated arrival date are shown with the price before you buy, counted from artwork approval and payment. You follow the status in your account.

faq.question: How do I choose the size of a cake box?
faq.answer: Measure the cake with its board and its highest decoration, then use the size search in the style library: it adds 0.5 cm on every side inside and recommends an inside size. Box sizes are entered in millimetres, length × width × height, inside.

faq.question: I have no design yet, or I already have a file — what do I do?
faq.answer: Without a design, create one in the 3D Studio or have the team design it (the fee is shown in the price). With a file, upload it and the team checks it before production. To design in your own software, download the dieline once signed in.

faq.question: Can I get a tax invoice?
faq.answer: Yes. Every order comes with a full tax invoice for the amount paid, and your branch can be stated.

Every order comes with a full tax invoice for the amount paid, you follow production and delivery in your account, and a reorder reuses the same spec and files, priced again at current cost.
